items.description:
The Alma Cafe is a live music and dinner venue on Alma Road in Rosebank, run as a second-generation, independently owned family business for more than 16 years. The venue took on its current form when the family that owns the historic building brought together a passion for hospitality and live music, building a home for live music, arts and community in the southern suburbs.

Today the cafe hosts live shows, intimate dinners, quiz nights, open mic sessions, live sport screenings and special events through the week, alongside its regular food and drink service. The space can also be booked privately for celebrations, corporate evenings and birthday parties. It suits music lovers looking for an intimate venue, as well as groups wanting a private function space with character.

The Bantry Aparthotel is a serviced-apartment hotel on Alexander Road in Bantry Bay, offering self-catering suites with views over the Atlantic Ocean and Lion's Head. The property has built up more than 1,800 guest reviews, with amenities including a communal swimming pool, a 24-hour front desk, secure parking, a restaurant, a bar and a terrace.

Rates start from around R2,250 a night, and photo identification is required at check-in. The property does not host events or parties, keeping the focus on guests looking for a quieter stay. It suits travellers wanting a self-catering base with hotel-style services in one of Cape Town's seaside neighbourhoods.

The Commons is a cafe, bar and cultural hub at Surfers Corner in Muizenberg, built around community, culture and connectedness. The kitchen and bar serve fresh, ethically sourced food and craft drinks that support local producers, with a menu that is vegan and vegetarian friendly, served against beachfront views.

Beyond the cafe, the venue runs a studio space for movement, creativity and mindfulness, and hosts a changing calendar of events from jazz and DJ sets to film nights and public talks. It also includes a vinyl and bookstore for browsing between sets. Walk-ins are welcome, and it trades Tuesday to Sunday from 8am to 11pm. It suits anyone looking for a relaxed beachfront spot that combines food, music and community events in one place.

VDS Roadhouse is a fast-food roadhouse on Kentucky Avenue in Colorado Park, known for its signature double and triple beef burgers, smash burgers and chips. The menu also covers sandwiches, hot dogs, gatsbys, wraps, salomies and milkshakes, giving it a broader range than a typical burger stand.

The roadhouse has built up a strong delivery following through third-party platforms, with a 4.7-star rating from customers who have ordered for delivery, and the menu is grouped so diners can filter by burgers, chicken, dessert or sides when ordering online. It suits Colorado Park and Mitchells Plain households wanting a quick burger or gatsby meal, whether collected in person or delivered to the door.

Wharfside Grill is a harbourside restaurant at Mariner's Wharf in Hout Bay Harbour, serving grilled seafood with views over the working harbour. It operates alongside the Wharfette Bistro and the Crayclub Bar as part of the same waterfront complex, with separate breakfast, bistro, kiddies and takeaway menus available across the site.

The complex also runs its own fresh fish market, Fisherman's Wharf, along with smokeries, live lobsters and an on-site bakery, so visitors can shop for seafood to take home after their meal. It suits anyone wanting a full harbourside outing, combining a seafood lunch or dinner with a stop at the fish market on the same visit.

Wheeler's Pharmacy & Medical Depot is a retail pharmacy in the Main Road Passageway in Hout Bay, offering dispensing services and a dispensary that can be reached directly by email for prescription queries. The pharmacy trades alongside its own linked Wheeler's Health & Homeopathic Emporium and the separate Sentinel Dispensary, both run from the same Hout Bay site.

The pharmacy itself is open Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 7pm, Saturdays from 8:30am to 6pm, and Sundays and public holidays from 9am to 6pm, longer hours than many community pharmacies. It suits Hout Bay residents who want a pharmacy with extended weekday and weekend hours, plus access to homeopathic products from the attached health shop.

Alpha Pharm Lentegeur Pharmacy is a branch of the Alpha Pharm pharmacy franchise on Merrydale Road in Lentegeur, Mitchells Plain, dispensing prescription medicines and other everyday pharmacy items. The pharmacy describes itself as providing a wide range of medicines and pharmaceutical services to the local community, with experienced pharmacists on hand for advice.

The branch trades Monday to Saturday from 8:30am to 5pm and Sundays from 8:30am to 1pm, giving residents seven-day access to a dispensary. It suits Lentegeur residents who want a local pharmacy for everyday medication needs close to home, including weekend hours for prescriptions that cannot wait until Monday.

Amanee Beauty Salon, on Main Road in Three Anchor Bay, offers a wide range of beauty services including acrylic nails, eyelash extensions, threading, microblading, waxing, manicures and pedicures. The salon describes its focus as bringing out the beauty in each client, whether they are in for a quick touch-up or a full makeover.

The salon trades Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm and Saturdays from 10am to 5pm, with bookings confirmed instantly online rather than waiting for a call back. It suits clients in Three Anchor Bay and Sea Point looking for a single salon that covers nails, lashes, brows and waxing in one visit, without booking separate appointments at different studios.

Breitling's boutique at the V&A Waterfront is run by The Vault, operating from Shop 107 in the Victoria Wharf Shopping Centre and offering the brand's full range of aviation, diving and chronograph watches. The boutique forms part of The Vault's broader watch and jewellery offering, which also includes brands such as Rolex, TUDOR, OMEGA, Panerai and TAG Heuer at other stores.

The Breitling boutique trades seven days a week from 9am to 9pm, among the longer retail hours at the Waterfront. It suits watch collectors and visitors to the V&A Waterfront looking for a dedicated Breitling boutique rather than a general jewellery counter.

Cafe Delicieux is a small cafe in the Welgemoed Forum shopping centre in Welgemoed, known as one of the Northern Suburbs' quieter hidden gems. It has built a following for brunches and light lunches, served in a space decorated with a quirky elegance.

On Friday evenings the cafe shifts to a sit-down dinner service, offering a different two- or three-course set menu each week rather than an à la carte list, so regulars keep coming back to see what is on next. It suits locals looking for a trendy, low-key brunch or lunch spot during the week, as well as diners wanting to try a changing weekly dinner menu on a Friday night.

Cape Town Fish Market is a seafood restaurant and sushi bar in Canal Walk Shopping Centre, Century City, serving seafood dishes, sushi and South African wines. The Canal Walk branch has a sushi belt, outdoor seating and a daily happy hour, alongside regular weekly specials.

The restaurant opens from 11am, with the kitchen trading until 10:30pm and the bar until 11pm from Sunday to Thursday, extending later on Fridays and Saturdays. Tables can be booked online, and gift vouchers are available to buy. It suits groups wanting a sit-down seafood meal with sushi options in one of Cape Town's busiest shopping centres.

Castor King is a supplier of castors, wheels, ladders, skates, trolleys and lifting equipment from its premises in Wetton, serving institutional, light, medium and heavy-duty needs. The range covers castors for bakeries, furniture, beds, scaffolding and ball-bearing applications, along with a wide choice of wheels to fit different castor brackets.

The business positions itself around knowledgeable staff, a large product selection, and competitive pricing, with customers able to visit the Wetton premises, call or email for assistance. It suits businesses and tradespeople across Cape Town needing castors or wheels for furniture, equipment or industrial trolleys, rather than a generic hardware store's limited range.

Cattle Baron De Waterkant is a steakhouse grill room and bar in the Mirage Building, within the Capital Hotel on the corner of Chiappini and Strand Street. The restaurant has become one of the trendier steakhouse concepts in Cape Town, with an elegantly decorated interior of rich wooden tables and intimate booth seating.

A covered patio area offers a more casual outdoor setting for guests who prefer to eat outside. Bookings can be made through Dineplan or Table Agent. It suits diners wanting a stylish steakhouse dinner in the De Waterkant and CBD area, with the option of a more relaxed outdoor table.

Cattle Baron Westlake is a branch of the Cattle Baron steakhouse chain, in the newly redeveloped Westlake Lifestyle Shopping Centre. The restaurant takes the classic steakhouse concept and gives it a more chic, modern finish, with floor-to-ceiling glass windows along the front offering views of Table Mountain and Devil's Peak by day and city lights at night.

The setting is designed to suit romantic dinners, social and family gatherings, and celebrations for special occasions, with the redeveloped centre around it adding more shops and parking than the previous building offered. It suits diners in the southern suburbs wanting a steakhouse dinner with a view, whether for a couple's evening out or a bigger family celebration.

Clarke's Bar and Dining Room is a restaurant and bar on Bree Street in the Cape Town CBD, known for its all-day breakfasts, signature cheeseburger and classic cocktails. The venue is especially popular for weekend brunch, drawing a steady crowd of regulars from the city centre.

It trades from 7am to 11pm on weekdays, from 8am on Saturdays until 11pm, and on Sundays from 8am to 3pm, giving it some of the longer daily hours of any bar on the street. It suits Bree Street regulars and visitors looking for all-day breakfast, a cocktail-friendly bar in the evening, or a reliable weekend brunch spot in the city centre.

Constantia Glen is a boutique wine estate in the Constantia Valley, producing cool-climate Sauvignon Blanc, Semillon and Bordeaux-variety wines. Visitors can book a wine tasting, a lunch or an early dinner, or a more social get-together, taking in sweeping views of the vineyards and surrounding mountains from the estate's venue.

The tasting menu runs to five different wine tastings, and guests can order something light to pair with whichever tasting they choose, alongside a wider lunch and dinner menu. It suits couples, friends and groups looking for a relaxed wine-tasting outing minutes from Cape Town, rather than a full day trip further into the Cape wine country.

Deer Park Cafe is a neighbourhood restaurant in Vredehoek that opens onto a public park overlooking the city, shaded by stone-pine and yellowwood trees. The weekly changing menu always features authentic Indian dishes, prepared under a chef from Goa, alongside vegan and vegetarian options, fresh pasta, hand-rolled wood-fired pizzas and a popular children's menu.

Ingredients are free-range, fresh, local and seasonal, and the drinks list covers good coffee, wines, craft beers and cocktails. The cafe opens daily from 8am to 9pm in winter and until 10pm in summer, and on busy summer days when all tables are taken, visitors are encouraged to order pizzas to enjoy on a picnic blanket in the park. It suits families and regulars wanting a relaxed, park-side meal with a reliably interesting menu.

Dimensions Tent & Structures is a Salt River-based company that designs and installs custom tents, steel-frame structures, mechanised blinds and outdoor heating for events and venues. Its product range covers Bedouin stretch tents, stretch tent linings and sidewalls, custom stretch tents, permanent structures, sailcloth tents, geodesic domes and luxury tented structures, available to buy or rent.

The company has more than 16 years of manufacturing expertise and has delivered projects in more than 30 countries, with all its fabrics carrying worldwide fire compliance and safety accreditation. It suits event planners, venues and rental companies needing durable, compliant tents and structures, rather than a basic party tent supplier.

Fields is a contemporary menswear brand based at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, crafting shirts, trousers, jackets and knitwear from natural yarns sourced throughout southern Africa. The brand positions its clothing as built for journeys from home to the workspace and from the streets to the outdoors, rather than for one specific occasion.

The Woodstock store is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm, Saturdays from 9:30am to 3:30pm, and Sundays and public holidays from 10:30am to 2:30pm. It suits shoppers looking for locally made menswear from natural materials, rather than imported fast fashion.

Food Lover's Market at Longbeach Mall in Noordhoek is a fresh-food supermarket with its own bakery, butchery, deli and fishmonger counters, alongside a wide fruit and vegetable selection. The store offers wheelchair-friendly access and its own wine section, with parking available at the mall.

Trading hours run from 8am on weekdays, with a slightly later start on Mondays, through to 6pm most evenings and shorter Sunday hours, and customers can sign up to receive the store's specials directly. It suits Noordhoek and Sunnydale households doing a full fresh-food shop in one stop, rather than driving further to visit separate specialist stores for meat, fish and bakery items.

Freddie Freeloader is a neighbourhood cafe in Salt River, opened in January 2018 out of its founders' love of making and eating food. Since then it has become a household name in the area, catering to the breakfast and lunch needs of the bustling Salt River and Woodstock neighbourhood.

The cafe serves breakfasts and lunches every weekday from a daily chalkboard menu that changes regularly, alongside wraps, toasties, bagels and croissant sandwiches. Coffee is a particular focus, with the barista behind the machine singled out by regulars for the quality of the brew. It suits locals wanting a reliable weekday breakfast or lunch spot with a changing menu rather than a fixed one.

Groot Constantia is South Africa's oldest wine-producing estate, founded in 1685 and now a national monument in the Constantia Valley. The estate offers wine tastings, cellar tours and vineyard visits, along with a wine shop that ships orders within South Africa and internationally.

Visitors can also browse the estate's Vintage Vault and gift shop, or join its wine club for ongoing access to its releases. The property's production cellar and historic Cloete Cellar form part of the visitor experience alongside the tastings. It suits history-minded wine lovers wanting to combine a cellar tour with tastings at the estate where South African wine began.

items.description:
CTP Cartons & Labels is a packaging manufacturer operating from Epping in Cape Town, on the corner of Bofors Circle and Dacres Avenue, with further plants in Elandsfontein and Industria in Johannesburg. The business specialises in general folding cartons, litho-laminated packaging, quick-service restaurant (QSR) packaging, shelf-ready packaging and packaging sleeves, covering a wide span of carton and packaging formats under one operation.

Running sites in both Cape Town and Johannesburg gives the business the reach to supply retailers, food manufacturers and quick-service restaurant chains across more than one region, rather than operating as a single local print shop. It suits FMCG producers, retailers and QSR brands needing folding cartons, shelf-ready packaging or litho-laminated packaging produced to order from its Epping premises.

Dis-Chem Pharmacy Tableview is a branch of the Dis-Chem pharmacy and health chain, trading from Shop 2 in Tableview Shopping Centre on the corner of Blaauwberg and Otto du Plessis Road. Beyond its dispensary and retail pharmacy counter, the branch runs its own in-store clinic and a separate Baby Wellness Clinic, alongside Click & Collect for online orders.

The pharmacy trades Monday to Friday from 9am to 7pm, Saturdays from 9am to 5pm and Sundays from 9am to 2pm, with the clinic and Baby Wellness Clinic running on their own shorter weekly schedule, including extended Saturday clinic hours on the first and last Saturday of the month. It suits Table View families and residents wanting dispensary, baby health and general clinic services together in one West Coast pharmacy.
